title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-09
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house recording of an average 1982 show with full bass and a well‑balanced mix.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the close‑up, rich‑sounding audience (FOB) capture, highlighting the full, distortion‑free bass and overall instrument balance. The performance itself is described as merely average for a 1982 Dead run, though Jerry Garcia’s vocals and guitar work are noted as better than usual. The combination makes for an enjoyable listen despite the unremarkable set.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is rated excellent by both reviewers, while the show is judged average; weighting these yields an overall rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Close‑up, rich FOB capture with full bass, no boom or distortion, and well‑balanced instrument mix – described as an audiophile’s dream.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply label the show as average for the era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Better than average vocals and decent guitar tone noted for this night.
